mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id AS kbId, grantee_type AS granteeType, grantee_id AS granteeId, permission, create_user AS createUser, create_time AS createTime FROM kb_grant WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT g.id, g.kb_id AS kbId, g.grantee_type AS granteeType, g.grantee_id AS granteeId, g.permission, g.create_user AS createUser, g.create_time AS createTime, CASE g.grantee_type WHEN 'USER' THEN COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username, CONCAT('用户#', g.grantee_id)) WHEN 'ROLE' THEN COALESCE(r.role_name, CONCAT('角色#', g.grantee_id)) ELSE g.grantee_type END AS granteeName FROM kb_grant g LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON g.grantee_type = 'USER' AND u.id = g.grantee_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON g.grantee_type = 'ROLE' AND r.id = g.grantee_id WHERE g.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY g.create_time DESC, g.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO kb_grant (kb_id, grantee_type, grantee_id, permission, create_user) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{granteeType}, #{granteeId}, #{permission}, #{createUser})
